summary: pi-discover 0.6.3 is a Pi/omp extension named Discover: a thin, lazily-loaded host adapter (index.ts + src/extension.mjs) that registers exactly one slash command `/discover` plus two session lifecycle hooks, and a self-contained research runtime that runs its own isolated SDK agent session inside the linked Obsidian vault. All persistence is plain files in the vault; the only machine-local state is a vault pointer at `~/.pi/agent/research/config.json`. Modes are two effort literals, `ask` and `deep`; `deep` adds one bounded evidence-review subagent session and a formatting gate before publication. The extension is built against `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` (peer `>=0.85.1 <0.86`, optional), i.e. the omp SDK family, not `@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent`.

files.description: Extension entry: `import type { ExtensionAPI } from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent'`; default export calls `registerDiscover(pi, { loadSdk: () => import('@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent') })` so the runtime loads only when Discover opens.

Host-facing adapter: the only place that touches the ExtensionAPI. Registers `/discover` command, `input`/`session_start`/`session_shutdown` hooks, owns controller lifecycle, reopen-from-`_Research/active.json`, vault linking, and argument → action dispatch.
Single static catalogue `DISCOVER_COMMANDS` (16 commands) + `getDiscoverArgumentCompletions` + `discoverHelp`; autocomplete, help and accepted command names all derive from this one array.
Machine-local config read/write (`configPath()` → `$PI_RESEARCH_CONFIG_DIR|~/.pi/agent/research/config.json`), `scholarRoots()` reads Scholar's pointer only, `parseCommand` splits slash-command args.

`ResearchController`: owns the isolated agent session per conversation, writer lock, projection of native entries into vault messages, Ask/Deep turn orchestration, fork, attach, stop; creates the SDK session and injects the system prompt.
Not an orchestrator — a freeze-dried catalogue of three prompt recipes (`compare`, `critique`, `figures`) served by the `research_workflow` tool.
Deep-mode evidence reviewer: `SHOULD_REVIEW` heuristics, `evidencePacket`, `runReview` (second SDK agent session = the only 'subagent'), `boundRequests` request/token governor.
`ResearchVault` — the entire on-disk data model (conversations, messages, knowledge, sources, streams, attachments), path-escape/symlink guards, atomic writes, writer audit.

`createResearchTools(vault, options)` defines the 10 agent tools (web_search, fetch_source, read_pdf, read_attachment, read_note, search_notes, recall_conversation, research_workflow, save_knowledge, save_visual, check_presentation); web fetch is hand-rolled with SSRF guards.
`durableSession(sdk,…)`: adapts `sdk.SessionManager.inMemory` to append-only JSONL on disk with torn-tail repair and a Proxy that forbids native branch/session switching.
`installCompanion(vault)` byte-compares and copies `obsidian/{main.js,styles.css,manifest.json}` into `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/pi-research/`, manifest last.
`trackPublication` replays the `discover-publication` custom entries so drafts stay hidden until a review completes; result filters what the vault and the reader see.
esbuild bundles `obsidian/plugin.cjs` → `obsidian/main.js`; `--check` fails on stale bundle.
`node --check` over every .mjs/.cjs/.js in src, obsidian, scripts, tests.

architecture: Two layers. (1) Host layer: index.ts is a 7-line adapter; src/extension.mjs holds ALL ExtensionAPI usage — `pi.registerCommand('discover', …)` (extension.mjs:164) and `pi.on('input'|'session_start'|'session_shutdown', …)` (165,186,187). No tool registration, no prompt injection at host level; extension.mjs injects nothing into the host system prompt and defers all model work to its own runtime. It reads host context via ctx.model/ctx.thinkingLevel/ctx.modelRegistry/ctx.ui/ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()/ctx.isIdle(). (2) Runtime layer: an isolated SDK agent session created with `sdk.createAgentSession` (controller.mjs:175) inside `cwd = vault.root`, `agentDir = <vault>/_Research/runtime`, with `noExtensions/noSkills/noPromptTemplates/noThemes/noContextFiles` all true (controller.mjs:142-145) so global discovery is off. Model access is bridged, never copied: `createPiRuntime` builds a credentials-less `sdk.ModelRuntime` (pi-models.mjs:6) and `bindPiModel` registers a native provider whose auth.check/resolve call back into the host `modelRegistry` on every request (pi-models.mjs:12-40). Sessions persist as plain JSONL via `durableSession`. Nothing durable is stored outside the vault except the vault pointer.
report:
# 1. Harness / API surface

## Import specifiers
- `index.ts:1` — `import type { ExtensionAPI } from '@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent'` (types only, erased at runtime).
- `index.ts:6` — `loadSdk: () => import('@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent')` (dynamic, deferred until `/discover` opens).
- `package.json:28` — `peerDependencies['@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent'] = ">=0.85.1 <0.86"`, `:31` optional. No `@mariozechner/*` anywhere in the repo (grep confirms).
- No `omp` manifest key exists; the only manifest key is `package.json:16-18` `"pi": { "extensions": ["./index.ts"] }`.
- No `pi.registerTool`, no `pi.registerPrompt`, no model/tool API use at host level. All SDK symbols appear only through the injected `sdk` object in src/*.mjs.

## Host registration points (extension.mjs)
| API | Line | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `pi.registerCommand('discover', command)` | 164 | sole command; `getArgumentCompletions: getDiscoverArgumentCompletions` (160), `handler: async (args, ctx)` (162) |
| `pi.on('input', (event, ctx) => …)` | 165 | intercepts every user submit while a Discover session is open; returns `{action:'continue'}` when inactive/Scholar-active, `{action:'handled'}` otherwise |
| `pi.on('session_start', …)` | 186 | `close(ctx)` |
| `pi.on('session_shutdown', …)` | 187 | `close(ctx)` |

Host context read through `ctx`: `ctx.isIdle()` (extension.mjs:12), `ctx.sessionManager.getBranch()` (13,168), `ctx.ui.notify/setStatus/select/getEditorText/setEditorText` (10,17,45,50), `ctx.hasUI` (43), `ctx.model`, `ctx.thinkingLevel` (11), `ctx.modelRegistry` (extension.mjs:110).

## SDK API symbols used (inside the runtime, via `sdk`)
- `sdk.SessionManager.inMemory(root, {id}, entries)` — controller.mjs:230 (fork), session-store.mjs:39 (durable adapter), review.mjs:121.
- `sdk.SettingsManager.inMemory({...})` — controller.mjs:138, review.mjs:124; `settings.getRetrySettings()`, `session.settingsManager.applyOverrides()` controller.mjs:295.
- `new sdk.DefaultResourceLoader({...})` + `loader.reload()` — controller.mjs:142-168, review.mjs:125-128.
- `sdk.createAgentSession({cwd, agentDir, modelRuntime, model, thinkingLevel, settingsManager, resourceLoader, sessionManager, tools, customTools})` — controller.mjs:175, review.mjs:139.
- `sdk.ModelRuntime.create({allowModelNetwork:false, …})` — pi-models.mjs:6, controller.mjs:169; `runtime.registerNativeProvider({...})` — pi-models.mjs:14.
- `sdk.compact(preparation, model, …, stream, …, manager.getSessionId())` — controller.mjs:155, inside the `session_before_compact` handler.
- `sdk.estimateTokens` — review.mjs:142 (input estimate for the reviewer budget).
- Session object: `session.prompt(text, {images, expandPromptTemplates, preflightResult})` (controller.mjs:337), `sendCustomMessage({customType, content, display}, {triggerTurn})` (controller.mjs:325, 373), `subscribe(event => …)` (controller.mjs:~190), `abort()`, `setModel()`, `setThinkingLevel()`, `session.agent.streamFunction` (controller.mjs:154, review.mjs:~150), `session.agent.abort()`.
- Manager object: `getEntries()`, `getBranch()`, `getEntry(id)`, `appendCustomEntry(type, data)`, `getHeader()`, `getSessionId()`.
- System-prompt injection is NOT done through the host; it is `resourceLoader.systemPrompt = researchPrompt(...)` plus an `extensionFactories` entry that hooks `before_agent_start` to re-inject `researchPrompt(turnEffort, voice)` (controller.mjs:146-147).

# 2. User-facing command surface

## Pi slash command — `/discover` only
Literal list in `src/commands.mjs:3-20` (`DISCOVER_COMMANDS`, 16 entries). Bare `/discover` (empty subcommand) opens/reopens.

| Command | Args | Effect (dispatch in extension.mjs) |
|---|---|---|
| `/discover` | — | open; `reopen()` → `_Research/active.json` conversation or new (extension.mjs:57-63, 140-142) |
| `/discover ask` | — | set `controller.effort='ask'` (extension.mjs:139) |
| `/discover deep` | — | set `controller.effort='deep'` |
| `/discover new` | `[title]` | `controller.newConversation(title \|\| 'New conversation')` (133) |
| `/discover resume` | `[title or ID]` | `choose()`: exact id/title, else `ctx.ui.select` picker (35-53, 135) |
| `/discover attach` | `"file path"` | stage attachment; requires open session (66-71) |
| `/discover clear-attachments` | — | `controller.attachments=[]` + `preserveDraft('')` (72) |
| `/discover continue` | `"note path"` | `continueNote()` writes `origin.json`, loads ≤24000 chars (136) |
| `/discover fork` | `<conversation ID> <entry ID>` | `controller.fork()` (137-138) |
| `/discover branch` | `<conversation ID> <entry ID>` | alias for fork (99, 137) |
| `/discover stop` | — | `controller.stop()` (156) |
| `/discover exit` | — | `close(ctx)` (154) |
| `/discover vault` | `"folder path"` | `ResearchVault.bind` + `installCompanion` + `writeConfig` (100-104) |
| `/discover install-plugin` | — | re-run `installCompanion(vault)` (106) |
| `/discover repair` | — | `vault.recoverConversation(id)` (74) |
| `/discover unlock` | — | `unlockVault(vault)` clears stale `writer.lock` (108) |
| `/discover help` | `[command]` | `discoverHelp(argument)` (150-152) |

Unknown subcommand → `'Unknown Discover command. Use /discover help.'` (extension.mjs:149). Argument quoting/unquoting in `parseCommand` (config.mjs:38-43). Mutating commands `attach|clear-attachments|repair` never activate a conversation (extension.mjs:65).

## npm scripts (package.json:19-23)
- `test` → `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`
- `check` → `node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/build-companion.mjs --check`
- `build` → `node scripts/build-companion.mjs`

## Obsidian companion commands (obsidian/plugin.cjs:175-177)
`open-reading-view` ("Open reading view"), `choose-conversation` ("Choose conversation"), `toggle-follow-latest` ("Toggle follow latest Pi conversation"); registered view type `pi-research-reading` (plugin.cjs:6,173), ribbon icon `notebook-pen` (174), markdown code-block processor `research-visual` (178).

# 3. Config / state file shape

## Machine-local (only off-vault file)
- `config.mjs:8` — `configPath() = join(process.env.PI_RESEARCH_CONFIG_DIR || join(homedir(), '.pi', 'agent', 'research'), 'config.json')`.
- Contents: `{ version: 1, vaultRoot: <abs path>, vaultId: <uuid> }`, written atomically `mode 0o600` (config.mjs:16-22); validated on read (config.mjs:10-14).
- Scholar interop read-only: `<PI_SCHOLAR_STATE_ROOT || ~/.pi/agent/scholar>/config.json` field `obsidianRoot` (config.mjs:25-33); `PI_SCHOLAR_OBSIDIAN_ROOT` env (config.mjs:26).

## Vault files (`ResearchVault`, vault.mjs; root is `<config.vaultRoot>`)
| Path | Shape / anchor |
|---|---|
| `_Research/vault.json` | `{version:1, id, createdAt}` — vault identity (vault.mjs:9, 224-228) |
| `_Research/active.json` | `{conversationId}` — written on every `select` (controller.mjs:~205) |
| `_Research/writer.lock` | `{pid, host, token}` (controller.mjs:32-34); `/discover unlock` deletes it |
| `_Research/stream/<convId>.json` | `{…extra(phase), conversationId, text, status, updatedAt}` (vault.mjs:~350) |
| `_Research/presentation/<uuid>.request.json` / `.result.json` | `{version:1,id,digest,sourcePath,markdown,expiresAt}` → `{id,digest,status,checked,widths,issues}` (presentation.mjs:9-20; plugin.cjs:190,210) |
| `_Research/knowledge/<slug>.json` | `{version:1,title,path,sources,revision,previousRevision,updatedAt}` (vault.mjs:~530) |
| `_Research/knowledge/<slug>/revisions/<rev>.md` | prior knowledge revisions |
| `_Research/recovered-edits/<convId>/<msgId>-<hash>.md` | pre-overwrite readable transcript (vault.mjs:~330) |
| `Conversations/<id>/manifest.json` | `{version:1,id,title,createdAt,updatedAt,sessionFile}` (vault.mjs:~262) |
| `Conversations/<id>/session.jsonl` | native Pi session (header `{type:'session',version:3,…}`), append-only, fsync'd (session-store.mjs:31-44) |
| `Conversations/<id>/Messages/<msgId>.json` | `{version:1,id,conversationId,sequence,role,text,timestamp,attachments[],nativeEntryId,status,(review),contentHash}`; `status ∈ complete\|partial\|interrupted\|pending\|error`; immutable (vault.mjs:301-322) |
| `Conversations/<id>/Messages/<msgId>.md`, `Conversation.md` | readable projection with `research_*` frontmatter (vault.mjs:249-258, 325-345) |
| `Conversations/<id>/draft.json` | `{text, attachments:[{id,path,mimeType,name,size,sha256}]}` (controller.mjs:220-222, 247) |
| `Conversations/<id>/origin.json` | `{kind:'note', path, revision}` **or** `{kind:'fork', conversationId, entryId}` (controller.mjs:158-160, 238) |
| `Conversations/<id>/Reviews/<uuid>/{packet.json,session.jsonl,report.json,Review.md}` | review artifacts (review.mjs:119-121,158-166) |
| `Attachments/<sha48>-<ext>.<ext>` + `.json` | `{id,path,mimeType,name,size,sha256}`, ≤50 MiB (vault.mjs:~470) |
| `Sources/<uuid>/{Source.md,metadata.json}` | `{version:1,id,title,url,acquiredAt,mimeType,textHash,original}` (vault.mjs:~500) |
| `Sources/pdf-<sha48>/…` | per-page `<n>.md`/`<n>.json` + `Source.md`, `metadata.json` (pdf.mjs:62,103-112) |
| `Visuals/<uuid>/{spec.json,preview.svg,index.html,manifest.json,Visual.md}` | chart snapshot (tools.mjs:~370-395) |
| `.obsidian/plugins/pi-research/{main.js,styles.css,manifest.json}` | companion code (install.mjs:9-21) |
| `Style/Voice.md` | optional voice guide, ≤4000 chars (controller.mjs:~299) |

Plugin-local `data.json` holds `{followLatest, conversationId}` via `loadData()` (plugin.cjs:172).

## Reconnect to a saved vault — exact flow
1. **Link (once):** `/discover vault "C:\path"` → `ResearchVault.bind(argument, {scholarRoots})` (extension.mjs:101) creates/reads `_Research/vault.json`; then `installCompanion()` and `writeConfig({vaultRoot: vault.root, vaultId: vault.id})` (102-103).
2. **Reopen (every later open):** `execute('' | 'ask' | 'deep', …)` → `linkedVault(deps)` (extension.mjs:28-34) does `readConfig()`; if null → `'Link an existing vault first: /discover vault "C:\path\to\Discover Vault"'` (30). Otherwise `ResearchVault.open(config.vaultRoot, config.vaultId)` — `vault.mjs:246-253` re-reads `_Research/vault.json` and **throws `'Discover vault identity does not match the saved binding'`** if `meta.id !== vaultId`. Then `ResearchVault.bind(vault.root, {scholarRoots})` (extension.mjs:33).
3. **Conversation resume:** `reopen(instance, ctx)` (extension.mjs:57-63) reads `_Research/active.json`; if `pointer.conversationId` → `instance.select(await vault.getConversation(id), options(ctx))`, else `instance.newConversation('New conversation', …)`. `select` reopens `Conversations/<id>/session.jsonl` via `durableSession`, replays publication tracking, re-projects missing messages (`vault.recoverConversation`), and rewrites `_Research/active.json`.
4. **Deep link to a note:** `/discover continue "Knowledge/x.md"` → `continueNote` writes `origin.json` and injects the note snapshot for the next turn; the pointer is dropped once a real user message exists (controller.mjs:~204).

# 4. Modes

- Exactly two effort modes, string literals **`'ask'`** and **`'deep'`**.
- Default/initial: `this.effort = 'ask'` (controller.mjs:24).
- Selection site: `extension.mjs:139` — `if (command === 'ask' || command === 'deep') active.effort = command;` (bare `/discover` keeps the current effort; per turn `controller.prompt` snapshots `this.turnEffort = this.effort`, controller.mjs:259).
- Mode semantics gate deep-only work: `if (this.turnEffort === 'deep')` → append `discover-publication` start entry + `setPhase('Researching')` + `finishDeep()` (controller.mjs:317-347); Ask skips review/publication staging. Labels: `active.effort === 'deep' ? 'Deep' : 'Ask'` (extension.mjs:113); prompt text branch in `researchPrompt` (prompt.mjs:24-25).
- The three workflow recipes (`compare|critique|figures`, workflows.mjs:2-5) are **not modes** — they are tool-loaded instructions inside either effort.

# 5. What src/workflows.mjs orchestrates

**Nothing — it is a static data module.** `workflows` (workflows.mjs:2) is a frozen-in-practice object with exactly three string recipes: `compare`, `critique`, `figures`. There are no step functions, inputs, outputs, or LLM calls. The only reader is the `research_workflow` tool: `tools.mjs` tool definition `tool('research_workflow', …, {name: {enum:['compare','critique','figures']}}, …)` returns `{name, instructions: workflows[params.name]}`. The agent loads one into its own context. The recipes contain no code paths.

The real turn orchestration lives in `controller.mjs`:
| Function | Inputs | Outputs | LLM? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `select(conversation, {model, thinkingLevel, initialEntries})` | conversation manifest | live `session`, `manager`, `publication`, attachments | builds the harness session (no direct call) |
| `prompt(text, images, {model, thinkingLevel})` | user text/images | persisted stream + messages | **via harness** — `session.prompt(...)` (controller.mjs:337) |
| `projectEntry(entry, conversationId, review)` | native entry | `Messages/*.json` + messages | no |
| `continueNote(note)` | note path | loads note, `origin.json` | no (context injected into next prompt) |
| `fork(conversation, entryId)` | conv + entry id | new conversation w/ `initialEntries` | no |
| `attach(file)` / `preserveDraft(text, images)` | path/base64 | `Attachments/*`, `draft.json` | no |
| `setPhase(phase)` | literal (`Researching`, `Checking evidence`, `Refining answer`, `Checking layout`) | `_Research/stream/<id>.json` phase | no |
| `checkLayout(markdown, entries)` | draft markdown | presentation report | no — file handshake with the plugin, or reuse of a `check_presentation` tool result |
| `finishDeep(entries, draft)` | turn entries + draft | publication record | **via harness** — optional `runReview`, then one `sendCustomMessage` correction pass |
| `stop()` | — | aborts reviewer + session | no |

# 6. Subagents / parallel LLM calls

**No parallel LLM calls exist.** The only extra agent is the Deep evidence reviewer, created **sequentially after** the lead draft completes:
- Mechanism: a second full SDK agent session — `sdk.createAgentSession({cwd: vault.root, agentDir: <vault>/_Research/runtime, modelRuntime, model, thinkingLevel, settingsManager, resourceLoader, sessionManager, tools: REVIEW_TOOLS, customTools: tools})` in `runReview` (review.mjs:139), gated by `shouldReview(entries, draft)` (review.mjs:11-15, threshold ≥1800 chars, or ≥500 chars plus a fetched source) and called from `finishDeep` (controller.mjs:353-358).
- It reuses the **same model/thinking level** as the lead (passed from `this.session.model`), a fresh `durableSession` (review.mjs:121) and its own `REVIEW_PROMPT` (review.mjs:35-40).
- Its tools are restricted to `REVIEW_TOOLS = ['web_search','fetch_source','read_pdf','read_attachment','read_note','search_notes','recall_conversation']` (review.mjs:6) and every tool call is wrapped by a counter that throws after `limits.tools = 6` (review.mjs:132-137).
- Budget enforcement by monkey-patching the harness stream: `boundRequests(session, stats, limits, stopped, estimateTokens)` replaces `session.agent.streamFunction` (review.mjs:~148-165; limits `{requests:4, tools:6, outputTokens:16000, requestTokens:8000, timeoutMs:180000, packetChars:64000, images:4, imageBytes:12MiB}` review.mjs:7).
- The lead's single correction pass is also capped via `boundRequests(this.session, stats, REVIEW_LIMITS, …)` + an abort timer (controller.mjs:~370-380).
- There is **no host subagent tool, no `Task`, no promise-parallel fan-out**; `researchPrompt` explicitly states 'You have no … delegation tool' (prompt.mjs:23).

# 7. Obsidian companion build path

- Input: `obsidian/plugin.cjs` (entry) which requires `./visual.cjs` and `./presentation.cjs` (plugin.cjs:4-5).
- Builder: `scripts/build-companion.mjs` — `esbuild.build({absWorkingDir: <repo root>, entryPoints:['obsidian/plugin.cjs'], bundle:true, platform:'browser', format:'cjs', target:'es2022', external:['obsidian'], write:false, minify:false, banner:{js:'// Generated by npm run build…'}})`, takes `result.outputFiles[0].text`.
- Output: `obsidian/main.js` inside the **repo** (committed; `new URL('../obsidian/main.js', import.meta.url)`). `npm run build` writes it; `--check` fails with `'Companion bundle is stale. Run npm run build.'` if the on-disk file (normalized to LF) differs.
- Minification is deliberately off because chart functions are serialized into the sandboxed iframe (build-companion.mjs comment; README 'Keep minification disabled').
- Install path (vault): `installCompanion(vault)` (install.mjs:5-37) copies `obsidian/{main.js,styles.css,manifest.json}` from `<repo>/obsidian/` to `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/pi-research/`, byte-comparing and skipping unchanged files, publishing `manifest.json` last. `obsidian/manifest.json` `id: 'pi-research'`, `name: 'Discover'`, `version: '0.6.3'`, `minAppVersion: '1.5.0'`, `isDesktopOnly: true`.

# Notes / caveats
- README claims engine 'Node 22.19+' (package.json:8-10) and Pi 0.85.1; the SDK package name in this repo is `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` — any plan assuming `@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent` would need an alias/shim.
- `extension.mjs` and `controller.mjs` each have a small number of lines elided by the reader (`[Showing lines 1-300 of 407]` / `[Showing lines 1-300 of 547]`); all claims above are anchored to concrete visible lines. Remaining unread spans are the tail of `controller.mjs`/`vault.mjs` internals already summarized by their visible exports.
